description: This source file implements the BufferParser class and related classes for parsing media buffers, extracting media segment data, and handling protection metadata in a GStreamer-based media pipeline.

classes.name: BufferParser
classes.description: Main class responsible for parsing media buffers and extracting media segments, including protection metadata and codec data.

classes.name: AudioBufferParser
classes.description: Derived class for parsing audio-specific buffer data, extracting sample rate and channel information.

classes.name: VideoBufferParser
classes.description: Derived class for parsing video-specific buffer data, extracting width, height, and framerate.

methods.name: parseBuffer
methods.description: Parses a GstSample and GstBuffer to produce a MediaSegment with associated data and metadata.

methods.name: addProtectionMetadataToSegment
methods.description: Adds encryption and protection metadata to a media segment based on buffer and structure information.

methods.name: addCodecDataToSegment
methods.description: Extracts codec data from GstStructure and attaches it to the media segment.

methods.name: parseSpecificPartOfBuffer (Audio)
methods.description: Parses audio-specific buffer data to extract sample rate and channel count, returning a MediaSegmentAudio.

methods.name: parseSpecificPartOfBuffer (Video)
methods.description: Parses video-specific buffer data to extract width, height, and framerate, returning a MediaSegmentVideo.
